title: camera
summary: A picture-taking device that opens doors to rooms across Europe.
question: Why does a picture-taking device share a name with rooms?
completion: You traced camera to camera obscura, then to the Latin room word camera. French chambre and Spanish cámara follow that older word too; Italian camera is another room-word relative. These are branches of a family, not a chain of borrowings between modern countries.
partner: Follow the sounds, places and meanings. What surprising connection will you discover?
